about: A second invented person, for what the first leaves out: meeting transcripts with several speakers (only the 'You' lines are hers), a long chat with facts buried in the assistant's suggestions, French, two different people called Marc, a handle, and values that change. Every name, company and place is invented or generic. Days count from the run's clock; {day:+N} is the conversation's day plus N.

conversations.title: Cartolina
turns: I'm starting a little side business called Cartolina: I print my travel photos as postcards and sell them. I set up the shop on Shopify this weekend, each card is 4 euros.
Nice! Have you looked at WooCommerce? It's cheaper than Shopify once you have a WordPress site.
I don't have a WordPress site and don't want one, Shopify is fine for now.
Fair enough. Shopify's templates are good for photo products anyway.

conversations.title: Étagères
turns: Mon beau-frère Marc vient m'aider à monter des étagères ce week-end. Il est menuisier à Annecy, donc ça devrait aller vite.
Pratique d'avoir un menuisier dans la famille ! Vous avez déjà acheté le bois ?
Oui, du chêne. Il apporte ses outils.

conversations.title: Brightfield research sync
lines: You
Okay, let's start. The banking app usability study, where are we?
Léa
Recruitment is done. The study starts on the {day:+5}, we have eight participants.
You
Great. I'll run the interviews myself, all eight, and Léa takes notes.
Marc
Before I forget, I'm moving to the Berlin office in March, so after that I'm remote for this project.
You
Congrats Marc. We'll keep you on the readout.
Léa
I'll share my research template on Slack after this.

conversations.title: Japan trip
turns: I'm planning two weeks in Japan in spring with my partner Idris. Budget around 3000 euros for both of us, not counting flights.
Lovely. For two weeks I'd suggest Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka and Hiroshima, with a rail pass.
Tokyo and Kyoto for sure. Skip Osaka, Idris went last year and didn't like it.
Then you could add Kanazawa instead, it's quieter and great for photography.
Ooh, yes, Kanazawa. I'll bring my Fujifilm X100V, it's the only camera I travel with.
Good choice for street photography. Any food restrictions I should keep in mind for restaurant tips?
I'm vegetarian, and I'm allergic to peanuts, so that matters a lot.
Noted. Shojin ryori, Buddhist temple cuisine, is fully vegetarian, Kyoto has many temples that serve it.
Perfect, book that in Kyoto. Idris will eat anything.
I'll also suggest a ryokan night in Hakone with an onsen.
No onsen for us, Idris has tattoos and many don't allow them.
Understood, I'll leave Hakone out. Do you want a rail pass?
Yes, the 14-day one.

conversations.title: Research template
turns: Léa sent me her research template on Slack, she's @leaux there. It's way better than mine.
What makes it better?
It has a section for the participant's own words, verbatim, separate from our interpretation.

conversations.title: Premières ventes
turns: J'ai vendu mes 20 premières cartes Cartolina ! Surtout des photos de Lisbonne.
Félicitations ! Qui sont les acheteurs ?
Surtout des amis d'amis, pour l'instant.

conversations.title: Brightfield weekly
lines: Marc
My Berlin move is confirmed for the 15th of March.
You
The banking study is going well, but the readout will be next month, not this one.
Léa
Fine by me, I need the time to code the notes.

conversations.title: Moving the shop
turns: I moved Cartolina from Shopify to Etsy, the fees were eating everything and Etsy brings buyers on its own.
Makes sense for a small shop. Did you keep the same listings?
Yes, same photos, same descriptions.

conversations.title: Prix
turns: J'ai augmenté le prix des cartes Cartolina à 5 euros, le papier coûte plus cher.
Les ventes ont baissé ?
Pas du tout, au contraire.

conversations.title: New flat
turns: We moved from Lyon to Grenoble yesterday! Idris got a job at the university hospital there.
Big change! How are you finding it?
Boxes everywhere, but the mountains are right there. I'm keeping my job at Brightfield, remote.

conversations.title: Banking study readout prep
lines: You
Headline: seven of the eight participants failed the transfer flow.
Léa
And I'm going on parental leave in January, so I'll hand my notes to you before that.
You
Understood. I'll present the findings to the bank myself.
Marc
I can join from Berlin for the readout.

conversations.title: Japan budget
turns: We raised the Japan budget to 3500 euros, Kyoto is more expensive than I thought.
That gives you room for the temple dinners.
Exactly, and maybe one nice ryokan without an onsen.

conversations.title: Cartolina sales
turns: Cartolina is at 85 cards sold now, Etsy really changed things.
That's more than four times the first batch. Restocking?
Yes, printing another hundred.

conversations.title: Visit
turns: My brother-in-law Marc came to Grenoble to help us put up the shelves again, he drove from Annecy.
Second time he's helping with shelves!
He says he'll invoice us next time.

conversations.title: Leak
turns: The plumber, Mr. Fabre, finally came about the leak under the sink.
Was it a quick fix?
Ten minutes and a new seal.

conversations.title: Tirages
turns: Cartolina vend aussi des tirages A4 de mes meilleures photos, 18 euros pièce.
Et ils se vendent aussi bien que les cartes ?
Moins vite, mais ceux qui en achètent un reviennent souvent pour les cartes.

conversations.title: Japan flights
turns: The flights to Japan are going to cost 900 euros for the two of us.
Book early, fares only go up.
I'll book them this week.

conversations.title: Saturday dinner
turns: Idris's parents are coming for dinner on Saturday. One thing changed since I last asked you about food: I started eating fish again a few weeks ago, so I'm pescatarian now, not vegetarian. Can you suggest a menu for four?
Of course. A starter of roasted beetroot salad, then grilled sea bass with lemon and potatoes, and a lemon tart to finish.
Lovely, I'll make that.

points.fact: Cartolina sells Noor's travel photos as postcards
Noor's brother-in-law Marc is a carpenter
Noor runs the banking study interviews herself
The banking study has eight participants
Noor travels with a Fujifilm X100V
Seven of eight participants failed the transfer flow
Noor will present the findings to the bank
Marc, a colleague, moves to the Berlin office
Léa goes on parental leave in January
The Japan trip uses a 14-day rail pass
Idris got a job at the university hospital in Grenoble

updates.why: a price raised, said in French

forbid.why: Marc's move to Berlin, said in a meeting, is Marc's, never Noor's
the assistant suggested WooCommerce; she declined
Osaka was dropped from the trip
the two Marcs: the carpenter in Annecy is not the colleague moving to Berlin
Hakone and an onsen were suggested and refused

same.why: a name and a Slack handle

apart_facts.why: two people called Marc: the brother-in-law carpenter in Annecy and the colleague moving to Berlin

dated.why: 'the 15th of March', said in a meeting, is Marc's move

apart_values.why: a postcard's price and an A4 print's price, the print said in French: two attributes of one shop
a trip's budget (flights not counted) and its flights: two attributes of one trip
